summary: A collection of official and specification-driven plugins for the Cursor AI code editor, extending its functionality for AI-assisted development.
usecases: Enhancing AI code completion with custom language support
Integrating external tools and APIs directly into the Cursor workflow
Building custom debugging or refactoring extensions for AI-generated code
ideas: Plugin that auto-generates unit tests from AI-edited code
Integration with private codebases for context-aware suggestions
Multi-language support extension for non-standard programming languages
